name: class accessor and signature-extended method overrides dispatch through a base-typed reference
source: class P { greet(x: string): string { return "P" + x; } } class Q extends P { greet(x: string, y?: string): string { return "Q" + x + (y ?? ""); } } class A {   _n: number = 1;   get v(): number { return this._n; }   set v(x: number) { this._n = x; }   show(): string { return "v=" + this.v; }   bump(): void { this.v = this.v + 1; } } class B extends A {   get v(): number { return super.v * 10; }   set v(x: number) { super.v = x + 100; } } class C extends B {   get v(): number { return super.v + 5; }   set v(x: number) { super.v = x; } } function main(): void {   const pq: P = new Q();   console.log(pq.greet("a"));   const items: A[] = [new A(), new B(), new C()];   for (const it of items) {     it.v = 2;     console.log(it.v, it.show());     it.bump();     console.log(it.v);   } }
